summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new admin Печать (Printers) actions: Тест / Текст / Картинка per printer card, plus emulator. Logged in as admin@resto.com, navigated via nav-printers. All 3 printer cards (Бар, Касса (пречек), Кухня) render the 3 new buttons plus edit/delete icons. Тест → toast 'Тест отправлен на «Бар»' + new 'Тест' job with status 'В очереди'. Текст modal (print-text-input/send-text-btn) → multi-line cyrillic text sent, modal closes, toast 'Текст отправлен на печать', 'Текст' job queued; empty text correctly blocked with toast 'Введите текст' and modal kept open. Картинка modal → set_input_files on hidden image-file-input shows filename + preview, send-image-btn creates 'Картинка' job, toast 'Изображение отправлено на печать', modal closes. Запустить эмулятор moved all queued jobs to 'Напечатано' (toast 'Напечатано заданий: 4') and the emulator modal rendered the cyrillic test slip and the custom text correctly; emu-close-btn closes it. All core acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Image jobs render only the placeholder line '🖼 Изображение отправлено на печать' in the emulator instead of a rendered raster/preview of the printed image — acceptable but a UX gap vs text jobs

One older 'Текст' job rendered in the emulator as only the header 'Кастомный текст' with no body lines (job created before this run); text jobs created in this run rendered the body without the 'Кастомный текст' header — header/body rendering for text jobs is inconsistent

action_items: Optional: render image jobs in the emulator modal as an actual monochrome preview (or note dimensions) instead of a plain placeholder line
Optional: make emulator rendering of 'Текст' jobs consistent (header + body) — an older job showed header only, new jobs show body only

Optional: invalid/corrupt PNG returns backend 400 and toast 'Не удалось обработать изображение: broken data stream when reading image file' — handled gracefully but the Pillow message is English; consider a fully localized message
critical_code_review_comments: Printers.jsx is 335 lines and already holds 5 modals; if more print features are added, extract the text/image print modals into separate components

image-file-input is intentionally hidden (class 'hidden') inside the dropzone label — tests must use set_input_files with the attached (not visible) locator; dropzone has data-testid image-dropzone which is the visible target
seed_data_creation: Created several print jobs (test/text/image) on printers Бар and Кухня; all were consumed by the emulator and left in 'Напечатано' state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Printers page IDs: Бар=6a8f30f5108c968f7b69f5df, Кухня=6a8f30f5108c968f7b69f5de. print-jobs table already has 120+ rows; newest job is the first tbody row. For image upload create a valid PNG (e.g. via Pillow) — a truncated 83-byte PNG causes a legit backend 400 'broken data stream'. Use state='attached' / set_input_files for image-file-input (hidden). Emulator processes ALL pending jobs, so create jobs then emulate in the same run to inspect their rendered content.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Initial STEP5 failure in the first test run was a test-script issue (waiting for the hidden file input to be visible) plus an intentionally invalid test PNG; both corrected in the test script and flows then passed.
